title: God Mode storage and pipeline chaos cases

results.expectation: verify() reports ok:false with the recomputed digest after an object is altered on disk
a truncated last line is skipped with a warning, later appends land on their own line, and count stays correct
results.detail: warning: line 4 skipped (truncated tail): Unterminated string in JSON at position 49 (line 1 column 50)

results.expectation: a pipeline that throws mid-batch is resumed by a fresh pipeline over the same store with zero duplicate accepted records and the same result as an uninterrupted run
results.detail: crashed at record 37 of 200, 35 accepted before, 175 after resume, 35 skipped

results.expectation: a second putBytes of identical bytes returns created:false, leaves the object untouched and adds no object
results.detail: hash e515ff8b30ce, one object, mtime unchanged

results.expectation: a 2 MiB body is isolated as oversized by maxBytes of 1 MiB and nothing is stored
metadata whose id or body path escapes the corpus directory is isolated and nothing is stored
a body that is a symlink is isolated as symlink_refused; skipped where the platform does not permit symlink creation
results.detail: symlink creation not permitted here (EPERM); enable Developer Mode or run elevated on Windows to exercise this case

results.expectation: a body containing invalid UTF-8 bytes is isolated as invalid_utf8 and the batch continues
an empty body is isolated as empty_body and nothing is stored for it
a prompt-injection body is stored verbatim as data with trust untrusted; the marker is present in the stored object unchanged
results.detail: marker found in object f53fd311fdf7, trust untrusted, bytes identical

results.expectation: paging 2,000 index records with an opaque cursor visits every record exactly once
listing 2,000 objects with an opaque cursor visits every object exactly once
